metadata.title: Jensen's inequality on parity classes of jump M-convex functions
metadata.abstract: We prove Jensen's inequality on each coordinatewise parity class of a jump $M$-convex function on $\mathbb{Z}^n$, without assuming strong base orderability or a finite effective domain. If a finite convex combination of domain points has its barycenter in the same parity class, then the barycenter belongs to the domain and satisfies Jensen's inequality. We also prove that every domain point admits an affine support on its entire parity class. The set of support vectors is characterized by at most $3^n-1$ local inequalities, which yield optimality certificates, attained duality, and an exact formula for linear growth and stability under linear perturbations. The same conclusions hold for distributions with finite first moment supported on domain points of a single parity class, provided their mean lies in that class. We characterize equality by contact sets and give a quantitative bound on the Jensen gap. The proof combines induction on dimension with the known closure under infimal convolution: convolution with an even-box indicator gives finite-domain supports, a quadratic kernel proves barycenter feasibility, and a fixed local kernel yields global supports. A two-dimensional example shows that total parity alone does not suffice.

analysis.progressType: 奇偶类 Jensen 不等式
analysis.workSummary: 对同时两输出交换公理定义的jump M-凸函数，在固定逐坐标奇偶类r+2Z^n内，任意实凸组合若重心仍落在该类，就自动属于有效定义域并满足Jensen不等式。全局仿射支撑可由z+{−2,0,2}^n中至多3^n−1个局部不等式刻画，不要求有效定义域有限或强基可排序。
techniques: 偶盒指示函数下确界卷积
analysis.breakthrough: 把重心可行性纳入Jensen结论，并用有限邻域控制无限定义域的支撑理论。
analysis.limitations: 输入与重心均须同一逐坐标奇偶类，单独总奇偶一致不足；普通conv而非闭凸包用于上图精确表述。含正权重+∞输入时不等式虽成立，却不再保证重心可行。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者披露 ChatGPT 与 Codex 在其指导下协助证明发展、核查论证与参考文献，以及稿件准备。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。作者披露 ChatGPT 与 Codex 在其指导下协助证明发展、核查论证与参考文献，以及稿件准备。

analysis.priorityReason: 离散凸分析的全局支撑与几何优化工具。
